name: Eisleigh
source:
A young scholar of magic who is extremely well-versed on various topics. Friendly and easygoing, she's a close associate with the master of the town's family.

Uses she/her pronouns.
Likes: Exploring new things and staying up late.
Dislikes: Being forced to do something uncreative.
